description: Tamban system model registry. SHA-256 values are computed from the actual checkpoint bytes. Record these alongside any finalized session export for reproducibility.
note: The active runtime (Model 1 + Model 2) uses models/fish_detector/weights and models/fish_quality/weights. The yolov26 and yolo_parts entries are alternative/experimental checkpoints not in the live inference path.

models.name: model1_fish_parent_detector.pt
models.semantic_class: Fish (whole-fish parent detector; label stored as item in checkpoint)
models.notes: Single-class detector. Class label is item in the checkpoint but treated as Fish by the runtime semantic contract.

models.name: last.pt
models.notes: 12-class part detection model. Evidence aggregated by region and grade per frame; not a per-fish classifier.

models.role: Model 2 alternative — YOLOv26m part detector (not in active runtime)
models.name: model2_tamban_yolo26m_partdet_r03_devbest.pt
models.notes: Experimental larger checkpoint from Tamban training round 03. Set FISH_QUALITY_MODEL_PATH to test against last.pt.

models.role: Part preview segmentation model (upload-test / part-preview mode only)
models.name: exp-4.pt
models.notes: Used only in LEMURU_MODE=part_preview for research upload analysis. Not used in live fish grading.
